{{Quote|Good bye, old friend. May the Force be with you.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to his former Padawan [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] before traveling to [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]|<ref name="Episode 3">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
[[File:OldBen-PM.png|250px|thumb|Obi-Wan Kenobi was known to use the phrase throughout his career as a Jedi.]]

'''"May the Force be with you"''' was a phrase used to wish luck or good will, generally when individuals parted ways or the object of the expression was facing some sort of imminent challenge. The phrase implied the speaker's wish that the power of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] would be working alongside the addressee, in order that the addressee's goals would be more effectively accomplished.

==Jedi==
The phrase originated with the ancient [[Je'daii Order]] as "May the Force go with you."<ref name="Into the Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref> Sometimes the phrase used was simply "The Force be with you."<ref name="Eruption">{{InsiderCite|141|Eruption}}</ref>

"May the Force be with you" was known to be used as a formal "'Goodbye' and 'good luck'" among [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and members of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] often recited it after assigning missions to their [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]]. After the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] it was adopted, even among non-Jedi, as a means of conveying good luck and hope before a battle, as a show of the ongoing struggle against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and admiration for the Jedi Order after their failed attempt to survive the corrupt [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor's]] power struggle.

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was known to have used a variation of this phrase, telling [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], ''"The Force will be with you. Always."'' shortly after joining with the Force, and shortly after Luke Skywalker successfully shot a pair of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] into the exhaust port of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], destroying it completely. Another variation was uttered by Luke, when he said "''May the Force be with me''" before entering the [[Cavrilhu Pirates]]' base.

Another variation is also ''"Then may the Force be with you"'' when [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]] wishes [[Galen Marek]] good luck, when he enters the Emperor's observation dome to free the rebels.

==Non-Jedi==
In [[3986 BBY]], [[Zayne Carrick]] did a practice fight with his friend [[Jarael]]. After the duel, Jarael and [[Gorman Vandrayk|Camper]] went in their ship with their droid [[T1-LB]], Jarael said goodbye to Zayne with "''May the Force be with you''".

[[Gar (Dantooine)|Gar]] was saying goodbye to [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] with "''Farewell, then. May the Force be with you, is that how it goes? Yes, may the Force be with you"''.

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] mockingly said ''"May the Force be with you, [[Meatbag/Legends|meatbag]]"'' to the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Glaive (Jedi)|Glaive]] after he was [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitated]] by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].<ref name="Republic 51">[[Republic 51|''Republic'' 51]]</ref>

After explaining the plan to destroy the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] said "''May the Force be with you''" to the pilots of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] before the mission.

Although not a firm believer of the Force, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], before leaving [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], said to Luke Skywalker ''"May the Force be with you"'' as a way of saying "good luck."<ref name="A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

Additionally, the phrase was used by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] just before the mission to destroy the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. To be precise, as Ackbar was personally leading the mission, he said ''"May the Force be with '''us'''"''.<ref name="Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Sith==
Another similar phrase, which Darth Vader used on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] to greet Luke Skywalker saying "''The Force is with you, young Skywalker,''" which perhaps expresses recognition and estimation of the foe's value and strength. Similarly, Vader insisted to a skeptical [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin]] that "[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan]] is here ... the Force is with him," before engaging in their last [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends#Duel_with_the_Dark_Lord|duel]]. On a more negative note, he also states, "May the Force.... give you what you deserve" to Leia Organa on [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]]. [[Uthar Wynn]] and [[Yuthura Ban]] during a mission in the Sith Academy on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] state a different version of the saying, namely "''May the Force serve you well.'' This, along with another variation; "May the Force ever serve you," was utilized three centuries later by the Sith Lord [[Lana Beniko]]. Another Sith variation of this saying was stated by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to his [[Galen Marek|apprentice]] shortly after his "death" saying "''Remember that the dark side is always with you.''"

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The Force will be with you. Always.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="A New Hope" />}}
The phrase is used by some characters in (and fans of) the films, meaning something like "good luck," although usually only Jedi and other believers in the Force use the expression. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who expresses his doubt about the Force in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']], eventually uses this expression to wish [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] good luck. In the expanded universe, it is revealed that the Alliance for the Restoration of the Republic used the phrase to call upon the legendary Jedi order, a symbol of the Old Republic, and also to differentiate themselves from the Empire.
[[File:SWDayMay4th-Logo.svg|thumb|right|250px]]
The expression has found its way into popular culture as a result of the popularity of the films. In 2005 it got the 8th position in the ''[http://www.afi.com/tvevents/100years/quotes.aspx AFI's 100 years....100 movie quotes]'' ranking.

Some might believe that, as the Force exists between all living things in any case, the phrase reflects a misunderstanding of its nature. In fact, the phrase implies a wish that the power of the Force is working alongside you, in order that your goals are more effectively accomplished. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Obi-Wan Kenobi once used a different form that expressed a reminder rather than a wish: "''The Force will be with you, always''", stating that Luke would succeed, as he was working alongside the power of the Force.

Some fans celebrate May 4th as "[[Wikipedia:Star Wars Day#May 4|Star Wars Day]]" by paraphrasing the phrase as "May the fourth be with you".
